svg.title: Upload to ISCC flow in iscc-web
svg.desc: The client posts the raw file body with an X-Upload-Filename header to POST /api/v1/iscc. The BlackSheep app, on its event loop, creates the package directory media/{media_id}/, writes {media_id}.meta.json and streams the body into the media file. It hands code_iscc(file) to a pool worker process with run_in_executor; the worker runs the CPU-bound iscc-sdk processing and returns the IsccMeta result. The app writes {media_id}.iscc.json and answers 201 Created with the ISCC metadata and a Location header pointing to /api/v1/media/{media_id}.
